summary: No box all round: every box.py rent from 21:44 UTC to the 08:15 cutoff was refused by the burn pace (two 0.39-0.40 $/h boxes held 0.79 of the 0.82 $/h limit), so no run, no eval, score None (score.py: 0 evals). Measured on CPU: the 9.27% dead end is the kill-teleport slab *18 (z 160) the goal field routes through, and the z 490 floor south of the platform is inside fall catch *7; the record pumps the pit under the slab, surfs a central ramp north over it and dives past its west edge. Reward-free Go-Explore (pbf config, + new --no-brake/--surf-hold/--strafe-share) falls 250-290 u of energy behind the record at the first ramp (t 1.5 s) and saturates in minutes; the bowl is a 0.1 s closed-loop strafe choice. Built and verified (tests, local smoke, record gate): tools/ge_spawns.py, tools/ckpt_retarget.py (pb_r26 as a uf2 warm start), the seed spawn file. Next: warm pb_r26 + GE spawns + per-call energy shaping, then the scratch recipe + --tick-ms 8 + --energy-pot 8 + the same spawns.
